reviews.author: Carpe Diem
reviews.text: I visited with some skepticism because the Korean bingsoo shop had closed down, but I was surprised by how delicious it was. It was a shame the pistachio flavor was sold out, but I will definitely visit again to try it next time.

reviews.author: Harris Hakimi
reviews.text: My go-to bingsu place!!! LOVE IT SO SO MUCH. flavours are immaculate and the prices are affordable, sesuai bawak family and friends! The staffs are friendly and lovely, just that kena makan for just 1hour to make way for other customers, understandable so yeah. Recommended!

reviews.author: kah seng
reviews.text: The bingsu was absolutely delicious! The ice was incredibly soft and fluffy, and the toppings were fresh and generous. Perfect balance of sweetness without being overwhelming. A refreshing treat that I’ll definitely order again

reviews.author: Hajar Aqielah
reviews.text: Always hits the spot! I literally am addicted to the Matcha Creme Brulee, the raya edition. Please make it a fixed menu because the matcha has really deep flavour, the creme brulee with a bit sweet and saltiness just perfectly in balance. Would highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Jin
reviews.text: We tried the roasted soybean oolong and it was superb! One of the nicest bingsu I had. Soft and flavorful with well and tasteful sides and cheese to add on to your liking. Clean and bright interior. Will be back!

reviews.author: Thivyashini Nelson
reviews.text: My favourite spot. The mango Sago is my most favourite and my daugher loves the matcha. I have a soft spot for the taro balls added into the mango sago. Most importsntly 2 awesome staffs in the counter. My 3rd trip here.

reviews.author: Hademay Tg
reviews.text:
Still my favourite dessert place♡
Their staff Iqmal came and ask us about how we feel about the new flavor - soybean osmanthus. He replace us a new one because it was less sweet. Thumbs up for the care for customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Cindy Dwi Utami
reviews.text: the pistachio bingsu is surprisingly satisfying experience that deserve attention, the presentation already sets expectation high, the texture is soft, airy, and melts smoothly on the tounge, making each spoon feel light rather than icy, the flavor is the highlight. Overall, the pistachio isn’t just “worth trying”, this is an easy recommendatiob

reviews.author: sherrywulifestyle
reviews.text:
First time visit and IN LOVE with their premium Matcha Bingsu! Light bitter matcha flavour is just right for me.

Tried their White Peach Oolong Bingsu too, slightly sour and refreshing! Portion is big, suitable for 2-4 pax per bowl.

Will definitely come back again😇

reviews.author: mugsey
reviews.text: Sooo good! Best bingsu ever! Love the pistachio one so much (not pictured) I think it was their most recent menu. They used real pistachio nuts for the toppings for that one, yum!! We came late at around 10 pm actually but had to queue for a while, so it was really packed when we arrived. No wonder la because they’re really good 👏

reviews.author: Light Snow
reviews.text: This dessert shop came highly recommended, so we decided to give it a try. I ordered their signature Roasted Soybean Oolong, and it definitely didn’t disappoint. The portion was just right for sharing between two people.

reviews.author: Ryan's Review
reviews.text: First try for their Pistachio bingsu, mahal nak mampuii but definitely taste good with good quality ingredients and paired well with the condiments provided ;) will come back again when I save enough for my sweet tooth cravings hehe

reviews.author: Jac Yim
reviews.text:
Brought here by a friend. Ordered the best seller oolong soybean, mango sago and Thai milk tea.
The oolong soybean was nice. Mango is a little sweet for us. The highlight for me is the Thai milk tea. I really love the combination. Nicely finely shaved ice with onde onde glutinous squares, topped with crushed biscoff, and bubble coconut fillings. Absolutely delicious! A must try if you come here.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text:
Came here at night around 10:45pm, still many customers inside. Managed to get a table within 5 mins.

We ordered Pistachio and Dark Chocolate bingsu. The pistachio shaved ice was perfect and rich from the first bite. Highly recommend you try if you like pistachios 👍🏻🔥.

Dark chocolate was rich as well, we paired it with the biscoff crumbs 👍🏻, lychee jelly 👍🏻and chocolate mochi 👎🏻.

reviews.author: fa
reviews.text: Lucky to find it empty on a random afternoon at 6pm because I know it is full at night. Amazing shaved ice dessert with a lot of flavour variations which can share for 2 people starting at RM23. I picked the White Peach Oolong flavour and will come again for other options!

reviews.author: Lin Han Yeong
reviews.text:
⭐ Update:
Came back for a second try and it was much better. The 1-hour limit was clearly stated and mentioned upfront. The pistachio and white peach oolong were both delicious ☺️.

My first visit wasn’t great - poor communication and being rushed out despite ordering more than others. Glad to see improvements and hope consistency stays.

reviews.author: Nasya Arina
reviews.text: full house. should open a bigger space for customers. thank god didn't need to wait for the seating. hard parking. big potions, extra fee for takeaway

reviews.author: Ohaiyo Simidaa
reviews.text:
The bingsu here is good. We tried the soybean and pistachio flavours, and both were rich, thick, and very tasty. You can choose two add-ons, and I highly recommend adding the chocolate butter crisps — they enhance the flavour and add a nice crunch to the bingsu.

Prices start from around RM24 and above for a bowl of bingsu, which is generous enough to be shared by two people.

The environment is slightly warm, and the interior design is quite simple. Overall, it’s a nice spot for dessert, especially if you’re coming mainly for the bingsu rather than the ambience.

reviews.author: Redherring “Redherring”
reviews.text: A pretty good dessert place. Another ice base dessert. Packed with people everyday.  Selection is decent.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Kok
reviews.text: Really delicious and refreshing bingsu. The shop has a nice minimalist vibe, but it is quite small, so it feels a bit tight when it’s crowded. Great for a fast chill-out session!

reviews.author: CW Wong
reviews.text:
Good desert place for bingsu. Well portioned and good price point!

We had the peach oolong one. The ice is fluffy and so soft, but well flavoured. Had no idea how to eat so wife poured the toppings on the mountain of ice and some fell on the floor 🙀

However this outlet had a strange smell, like something rotting. It made us not want to linger too long.
